The evidence suggests that EGCG acts as a target for LoVo, which in turn is targeted by Fatsicarpain D, and Fatsicarpain D targets ME-180. This chain of interactions implies a potential mechanism by which EGCG may influence ME-180 through the LoVo cell line, possibly via the Fatsicarpain D pathway. The overlapping targets between LoVo and ME-180 suggest a possible functional relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the molecular interactions involved, and further studies would be needed to confirm the direct or indirect role of EGCG in targeting ME-180.
